name: GA-evolved 1D binary CA for density classification (EvCA)

physics_size.world_dims: 1D ring N=149, radius 3, ~2N steps per IC
physics_size.step_cost_est: ~1e7 cell-updates per rule evaluation at 100 ICs (EST)

phenomenon_of_interest: cross-search-physics recurrence with GP and coevolution (fam-125)

artifacts.data: REPORTED (best rule tables printed in hex)

provenance_class_attainable: REIMPLEMENTATION if GA fully specified else APPROXIMATE_RECONSTRUCTION
kill_observation: Under faithful physics at >=1e4 runs, transition to particle-based strategies is fully predicted by generation count and mutation-rate alone with no dependence on ancestral rule-table structure (i.e., no historical contingency).
notes: First-experiment recommendation. Verify: GA parameters, elitism fraction, IC distribution, number of runs, fraction of runs reaching particle strategies, existence and license of EvCA source.

name: Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma with variable-length memory genomes

physics_size.population: replicator dynamics over strategy frequencies (deterministic) + mutation

phenomenon_of_interest: duplication followed by divergence (gene-duplication operator is neutral at creation)
kill_observation: Duplication events do not change the subsequent distribution of successful point mutations relative to matched non-duplicated lineages (no Effect on accessibility).
notes: Runner-up first experiment. Cleanest historical instance of the section-14 shape with tiny physics.

name: Avida: evolutionary origin of complex features (EQU) with deleterious intermediates

artifacts.source: KNOWN (avida on GitHub, verify version parity)
artifacts.data: REPORTED (lineage of the focal run; verify availability)

kill_observation: N/A as calibration: if our blind detector cannot flag the deleterious intermediate before EQU appears, the detector fails calibration.
notes: CALIBRATION PARTICLE, not a first archaeology target: the original detector already retained full lineage and performed the ablation.

name: RNA secondary-structure evolution in a flow reactor: neutral drift, relay series, continuity of transitions

artifacts.source: KNOWN (ViennaRNA; energy-parameter set of the era must be pinned)

provenance_class_attainable: APPROXIMATE_RECONSTRUCTION unless era parameter set recovered
kill_observation: Relay-series statistics are indistinguishable between the historical parameter set and a randomised-energy control.
notes: Original detector was unusually good (relay series = lineage). Blindness is in replication count and counterfactual forks, not in observation.

name: Royal Road functions: hitchhiking; RMHC outperforms GA
notes: Calibration: a detector must recover hitchhiking as the cause, blind.

name: Hinton-Nowlan Baldwin effect; persistent question marks explained as drift (Harvey)
NEAT: complexification + speciation protection + historical markings, with component ablations
kill_observation: Ablations measured contemporaneous fitness only; if protection does not change descendant acquisition rate under an evolvability measure, the part is ordinary adaptation aid, not meta-adaptation.
notes: Calibration set for parts A/B; blindness: no evolvability measurement.

name: Intrinsic hardware evolution of a tone discriminator on XC6216 with disconnected-yet-necessary cells
kill_observation: Physics irreproducible; interest is detector-archaeology only.
notes: Canonical case where the specimen cannot be reconstructed; document as such.

name: Autoconstructive evolution in Push (Pushpop / AutoPush)
kill_observation: Collapse/persistence outcome is explained entirely by program-size drift with no dependence on evolved reproduction operators.
notes: 10,000x candidate: collapse frequency as a distribution.

name: Aevol: complexity ratchet and indirect selection on genome structure
kill_observation: Ratchet disappears under matched-fitness controls with randomised genome structure.

name: POET: paired open-ended trailblazer (environment-agent coevolution with transfer)
phenomenon_of_interest: temporary access to previously unreachable states (measured vs direct optimisation)
kill_observation: Reachability advantage vanishes when direct optimisation gets matched compute and a curriculum of the same environments.
notes: Modern end; the authors ran the key counterfactual already (check its n and SE).
